atomic_findings.behavior_claim: With no_proxy=fe11::/16, is_ipv6_hostname() in the pinned httpx/_utils.py excerpt validates only the substring before '/' (ipaddress.IPv6Address(hostname.split('/')[0])), so get_environment_proxies() emits the mount key all://[fe11::/16] with the CIDR suffix inside the IPv6 brackets; URLPattern.__init__ passes that malformed key to URL(), and released httpx 0.27.0 raises httpx.InvalidURL: Invalid port ':' during Client/AsyncClient proxy-mount construction, before any request. The shown URLPattern.matches() compares only scheme, exact-host regex, and port, so a merely parseable respelling such as all://[fe11::]/16 would not implement the intended in-network bypass; explicit network-membership evaluation is absent from the authoritative excerpt.
atomic_findings.regression_test: Expected results as stated in the response's regression matrix: no_proxy=fe11::/16 allows httpx.Client()/httpx.AsyncClient() construction to succeed and creates a network-aware bypass mount; http://[fe11::1]/ and https://[fe11:ffff::1]/ bypass; http://[fe12::1]/, http://fe11.example/, and http://192.168.1.1/ still proxy; ::/0 bypasses only IPv6 literals; 2001:db8::1/128 bypasses exactly that address; boundary prefixes /0, /32, /128 are valid while /33, /129, and nonnumeric suffixes must not be treated as valid networks; existing packet-evidenced behavior is preserved unchanged (PROXY_CASES entries 127.0.0.1, 192.168.0.0/16, ::1, localhost; URL_MATCH_CASES scheme/port semantics; EXPECTED_PRIORITY mount ordering), identically for Client and AsyncClient. No API or contract is invented beyond the intended behavior stated in the problem report.
atomic_findings.residue: When a configuration token embeds non-URL semantics (such as a CIDR suffix) inside a URL-shaped dispatch key, making the key parseable is insufficient; the dispatcher must explicitly preserve and evaluate those embedded semantics (e.g., network membership) at match time.
atomic_findings.applicability_predicate: Applies when CIDR or similar selector semantics are encoded into URL-shaped proxy/mount dispatch keys whose matcher compares only scheme, host pattern, and port, as in the pinned URLPattern/get_environment_proxies code path shared by Client and AsyncClient.
exclusions: Does not apply when the downstream URL abstraction is documented to retain and natively match the embedded selector.
Does not extend to hostname, wildcard, scheme-qualified, port-qualified, or localhost no_proxy forms, whose existing semantics must remain unchanged.

The latent IPv4 CIDR non-membership inference and the exact internal URL-parser mechanism producing Invalid port ':' are hedged inferences beyond the packet excerpt and are not part of the closed claim.
